what: bậc xuống bãi tắm, a flight of steps of granite from the walk of the sea down to the sand of Bãi Trước
uses: Plan 0026, R10, Q11: at the gaps and the ends of the sections of the low wall of the beach. Their places: Check (the photos do not give them).

photos.author: Flickr user 110569822@N04
photos.shows: The north part of Bãi Trước from the beach, to the north (Núi Lớn with the cable car): the low wall of granite blocks with square posts and openings on the right, a flight of three or four steps down to the sand at the end of a section, a wider stair farther along, swim rings, people on the sand.

photos.author: VnExpress
photos.shows: The south part of the beach full of swimmers at the end of the afternoon: the low wall with balusters in sections on the sloped stone sea wall, a stair down to the sand in a gap between two sections, swim rings, light blue lamp poles behind the palms.

photos.author: Ted McGrath (time-to-look)
photos.shows: Painted fishing boats on the sand at low tide; behind them the low wall with balusters on a stone base in sections, with gaps and small steps, palms and light blue lamp poles.

checks: Views: from the sand, from the walk, side.
Three or four steps of granite from the walk to the sand, between the ends of two sections of the low wall.

envelope.depth.how: Four treads of about 0.4 m: a guess.

envelope.height.how: Photo 0: the walk is about 1.3 m over the sand at the steps (the wall of 1.0 m stands about 1.3 m over the sand on the beach side).
